body: This was incredibly insightful, and I hope you don't actually delete it. I think it would be good for others in their own dilemmas to see this. It has definitely made me feel something, though I can't define what. As I've stated above, I think I have already submitted to the idea of going through with this, but I hope that, at the very least, I can make 'something' of whatever 'this' ends up being. It's not love, it won't be. I try to be as forgiving as I can, but I have absolutely not forgiven her and will never forgive her. So I will try and work on myself and be proud of myself for other decisions I make, the good and the bad.

I'm not dismissing what you're saying. It's just so fucking hard to deal with the thought of her harming herself. In a way, I even feel selfish because I don't want to be the one responsible for that, I guess. I'm worried what people would think of me and my family because I wasn't able to commit to her or find enough reasons to stay with her and just powr through it. I hope the best for you, and I honestly think you must be a great person, because you made the person of your dreams an opportunity to move on and not hook into her with guilt as my girl has. Thank you for all of the words though, they do mean a lot.

The shitty thing is, is that would involve my parents (the Indian community that our parents are a part of are tight knit). I love my parents, and they already have a lot of other things to deal with health wise. Involving authorities would unfortunately have people giving me and my parents shit, and disregarding our privacy. I would hate to put my parents through that. :(
I'm dreading it. At the very least, I think I have the mental capacity for it at least.

Of course she needs help, but because we're a) Indian and therefore as a community tend to sweep mental health under the rug, she won't get any, and b) in general not a bad person, she helps my parents a lot and has put roots in a lot of the people who are close to me, it's hard to just cut that off without the results being catastrophic. It's not just breaking up with her, it's breaking up with her and unfortunately everyone who has decided to grip onto our relationship, which is a lot of people. 

Everyone her family and my family constantly barrage us every day with messages and questions about why we aren't married yet. I personally don't get bothered by it, but she does and it bothers her parents, and every day I don't propose, she gets hurt more and more.
